caption:
Missed a question? Don't read the explanation yet.

Check only the right letter, cover the explanation, and re-solve toward it. Then read the explanation and compare.

Save this for your next review session.
tiktok_caption: Missed a question? Don't read the explanation yet. Find your own mistake first.

youtube.title: SAT Study Tip: Find Your Mistake Before the Explanation
youtube.description: When you miss an SAT practice question, check only the correct answer and re-solve it yourself before reading the explanation.
